lines.speaker: board
lines.name: JUDGE KERN
lines.text: Don't. We can pay. Name a number.

lines.speaker: board
lines.name: CORNELIUS ALDANE
lines.text: It was real. The old man had to go. The city was for sale, and we were the only buyers.

lines.speaker: board
lines.name: THE MAYOR
lines.text: Malaspina took the dog. A lever, that's all. Just a lever.

lines.speaker: board
lines.name: CORNELIUS ALDANE
lines.text: Don't you see it? Every man you broke was one of ours. In order. Someone has been reading you our guest list.

lines.speaker: board
lines.name: JUDGE KERN
lines.text: Ask the man on the roof. He isn't ours.
